verses.text: Ha hin Pablo hin tik, winhaj Silvano yet' winhaj Timoteo, sko tz'ib'ejb'at jun carta tik t'ayex hex iglesia hex t'a Tesalónica. Yik hexxo ko Mam Dios yet' Kajalil Jesucristo. Ayokab' wach'k'olal yet' junk'olal t'a he kal ta'.
Skak' wal yuj diosal t'a Dios heyu'uj he masanil. Juntak el tzonh lesalwi, tzex ko nakoti.

Ha t'a yichanh ko Mam Dios sko nakoti to niwan tzex munlaj t'ay, yujto ix heyak' wal och t'a he k'o'ol. Sko nakoti to tzeyak' serwil Dios chi', yujto te xajan heyu'uj. Hanhejtona', tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, yujto anhej Kajal Jesucristo tzeyak'och yipok he k'o'ol.
Xajanab'il hex yuj Dios, yujto ha sik'jinak hexxo kaneli.

Ayik kek'nak kalel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'ayex, manh tonhejok komon lolonnak honh. Yujto ha Yespíritu Dios ochnak ket'ok. Kojtak wal sik'lab'il to te yel jun ab'ix tik. Heyojtak paxi chajtil kutejnak ko b'eyb'al t'a he kal yuj he wach'il.

Ha hexxo, ochnak hex ijan he b'eyb'alan ko b'eyb'al chi'. Ix he b'eyb'alan pax sb'eyb'al Kajal Jesús. Wach'chom niwan syahelal ix heyab'i ayik ix he cha'an slolonel Dios, palta te tzalajk'olal ix he cha'a, yujto ha Yespíritu Dios ix ak'an he tzalajk'olal chi'.
Yuj chi', ix he ch'oxel jun wach' b'eyb'al t'a masanil heb' ketcreyente'al t'a yol yik Macedonia chi' yet' t'a yol yik Acaya tik.

Heyu'uj ix pukaxb'at yab'ixal Kajal Jesús t'a junjun lugar. Ix laj yab' heb' aj Macedonia chi' yet' heb' aj Acaya to tzeyak' wal och Dios t'a he k'o'ol. Manhoknhej heb' ix ab'ani, ix laj yab' pax heb' ay t'a junjun lugar. Yuj chi', manhxo yowalilok ha honh skalel heyab'ixal t'a skal heb' anima.

Yujto masanil mach wan yalan heyab'ixal to wach' ajnak honh he cha'ani ayik kek'nak t'ayex. Wan laj yalanpax heb' chajtil heyutejnak heyaktankan juntzanh heyak'nakoch he diosalok, ix hex och pax ijan heyak'an serwil Dios pitzan, haton jun Dios te yel.

Hanhejtona' syalanpax heb' to wan he tanhwan yemxul Yuninal Dios t'a satcha'anh, haton Jesús. Ha Dios ak'jinakxi pitzwok t'a skal heb' chamnak. Haton tzonh kolankanel t'a yol sk'ab' jun niwan yahelal ol jawok yuj yowal sk'o'ol Dios.
